name: Frogadier
description: Frogadier, the Bubble Frog Pokémon, and the evolved form of Froakie. Able to evolve into Greninja. A Water type.
pokedex_entries: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute's time.
